messages.author: 9bb5e4d1a0c3661a
messages.subject: Re: Error in as.environment(where) : 'where' is missing
parts:
Thank you for your reply. As ggplot seemingly did not recognised dates I figured out what the problem with the help of a colleague at work. The issue was that the date format in the original datasets which I had imported had changed and as a result the code to transform the date to R had transformed all to NAs. No that the problem is sorted, ggplot works fine.

Thanks,

Roberto

messages.author: d34d025a513c07fc
messages.subject: Re: Error in as.environment(where) : 'where' is missing
parts:
You need to wrap the aesthetic mappings in aes(), as in:
ggplot(data=MSAs, aes(x=lat, y=long, size=pop, col=dollaz2009/pop)



On Mon, Mar 11, 2013 at 4:39 PM, Lao Tzu <chris.d....@gmail.com> wrote:
I got the same error. 

> g <- ggplot( data = MSAs, x=lat, y=long, size=pop, col=dollaz2009/pop)
> g + geom_point()
Error in as.environment(where) : 'where' is missing
I uploaded the MSA's data set here: http://ge.tt/1bpgboa. Maybe you can get the same error with that.
